metadata.coverage: Selected Bangkok and Chiang Mai retail neighborhood cores only. Not a national neighborhood registry.
metadata.membership: Point-in-polygon against fixed features, independent of filters; no nearest fallback.
metadata.consensusEvidence: No consumer survey or community boundary approval; named-place evidence and analyst-selected physical edges are separate.

properties.boundaryAuthority: CityMETER analyst interpretation; not statutory, community-endorsed, or survey-measured
